cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Please say what my spreadsheet added to the successful trip. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. With what?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Add 'all thirty missing bookings' and I'll recognise the achievement.

mechanism: A guides a short trip summary by reducing B writing burden and pressing broad praise into the exact bookings recovered.
confusable: Unlike asking for any acknowledgment, A wants what the spreadsheet actually added to the trip result.
comparison: A succinct operational summary differs from public festival speech credit.
seedUse: D201-b spreadsheet and thirty bookings; S02-b requests one useful line rather than a flattering explanation.
